definitions.key_present_in_artifact: true when every .get("literal") key path the check reads in its r9 branch is written somewhere in the artifact it reads
definitions.checks_with_missing_keys: number of the ten checks that read at least one key path the artifact never writes; .get() then returns None and the branch behind it cannot fire
definitions.dead_read: a read whose EVERY candidate path is absent, i.e. the assertion that depends on it can never be exercised
definitions.reads: key paths resolved from the AST (assignment chains + list scopes), not regex hits
definitions.fired: the check returned ok is False after the artifact's real field was mutated
